remarks: Step into this inviting 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom condo, offering a perfect blend of space and style. The primary bedroom comes complete with a generous walk-in closet and a private half bath, creating your own personal retreat. Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day on the private balcony, an ideal spot for relaxation. Inside, you'll appreciate the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer hook ups, along with central air conditioning to keep you cool during the warmer months. Forget the hassle of extra expenses; heat, hot water, flood insurance, security surveillance, and on-site maintenance are all included in the monthly common charges. Pet lovers will feel right at home in this pet-friendly community, which also features abundant parking just steps from your door and additional storage space for all your needs. Candlelight Terrace isn't just a place to live-it's a vibrant lifestyle. Imagine spending sunny afternoons by the in-ground pool, hosting weekend cookouts with friends, or taking peaceful walks along the picturesque Rippowam River surrounded by lush greenery. With downtown Stamford only minutes away, you'll be close to shopping, dining, and entertainment, plus there's ample visitor parking for when friends and family stop by.
